field_tips.main_images: Product-level images: [{"uri": "..."}]. Minimum 1 required. Upload via image uploader first.
field_tips.image_upload: Use multipart/form-data with field name 'data'. Sign with empty body.
field_tips.brand: Pass brand_id as empty string "" for No Brand. Do NOT create custom brand.
field_tips.sales_attributes: Format: [{"name": "Size", "value_name": "M"}]. Add sku_img for visual dimension.
field_tips.size_chart: Field: {"image": {"uri": "..."}}. NOT 'size_chart_image'. Omit if not provided.
field_tips.description: HTML format, English only, minimum 80 characters.
field_tips.color_size: All color and size values in sales_attributes must be English.
